events.title: Crystal Ascend Dev Log Episode 11
events.summary: Hey everyone, this is Zodiac GameLab. The incremental game Crystal Ascend has made some progress!Before I knew it, I’ve already posted 11 dev logs. It’s quite satisfying to see the game gradually becoming richer in my own hands.Enough small talk – the element finished this time is — Dark. The dark element brings to mind darkness, power from the abyss.
